overview: The Hall of Edicts is where the Tribunal’s doctrine becomes binding law. Every decree, purity mandate, and enforcement directive originates here.
history: Constructed during the earliest consolidation of Seru’s rule.
Arcane decree chambers were added to stabilize doctrinal magic.
Purity scriptoriums were introduced to prevent ideological corruption.
Praetorian oversight galleries were integrated to enforce compliance.
hooks: A new edict destabilizes decree chambers.
A purity scriptorium reports a corrupted manuscript.
A Praetorian officer requests assistance with a classified decree.
A sealed Tribunal mandate arrives unexpectedly.
